resources.string: Open Aster on a device where Aster Guard is on, such as the browser or desktop app you used to turn it on. Open the request there and enter this number to approve it.
This request expired. To try again, sign in again.
This sign-in was denied on another device.
You can finish signing in on this phone after %1$s.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
That code doesn\'t match. Check the code and try again.
This sign-in was approved. To finish, enter your password again.
Aster couldn\'t finish this sign-in. To try again, sign in again.
Number to enter on your other phone: %1$d
Sign in with Aster Guard on this phone
Sign-in requests and changes to your account that Aster Guard protects
Someone is trying to sign in to your account. Tap to review the request.
A change to your account is on hold. Tap to review it.
A change to your account that was on hold is now applied.
A change to your account that was on hold was canceled.
Your other sessions were signed out and pending changes were canceled.
Someone started a rescue for your account. If it wasn\'t you, tap Review to stop it.
The rescue for your account was stopped.
New sign-ins now need approval from a phone where you\'re signed in.
Sign-in requests for your account are paused for a while.
Add a device to Aster Guard
Someone is trying to sign in to your account. If it\'s you, enter the number shown on the new device.
A new device wants to join Aster Guard. If it\'s yours, enter the number shown on that device.
That number doesn\'t match. Check the number on the other device.
Aster couldn\'t send your answer. Check your connection and try again.
Aster Guard keeps your approval key locked until you unlock Aster Mail. Unlock it to review this sign-in.
The new device can finish signing in.
The other device can\'t sign in. If someone else has your password, change it in Settings.
This request is no longer active.
This phone can no longer approve requests. To use it again, set it up in Aster Guard settings.
This phone isn\'t set up for Aster Guard.
To approve a sign-in on a device that can\'t get notifications, enter this code there.
Your Guard code is hidden. To show it, confirm it\'s you.
A new code appears in %1$d seconds
This phone has no Guard code. To get one, add this phone to Aster Guard again.

Aster Guard asks a phone you trust to approve new sign-ins and holds risky changes to your account for 24 hours. If someone gets your password, they still can\'t get in or change your account without that phone.
Aster Guard isn\'t available for your account yet.
Aster Guard couldn\'t turn on. Check your connection and try again.
This phone already approves sign-ins and changes for your account.
You can change these later in Security settings.
A new device needs approval from this phone before it can sign in.
Changes like these wait 24 hours, and you can stop them.
New forwarding addresses and mail rules wait before they start.
Password, two-factor, and recovery changes wait before they apply.
Data exports and private key downloads wait before they start.
A new app password or mail app works only after you approve it.
Account recovery takes 72 hours, so you have time to stop it.
If you lose this phone, your rescue code is how you get back into your account. Keep it somewhere safe and offline. Aster can\'t show it to you again.
To make sure you saved it, enter the last 5 characters of your rescue code.
That doesn\'t match your rescue code. Check it and try again.
To turn on Aster Guard, enter your account password.
Enter the code from your authenticator app.
Aster Guard needs you to confirm it\'s you. Try again.
To use Aster Guard, set a screen lock on this phone.
New sign-ins now need approval from this phone.
Add this phone to Aster Guard
Aster Guard is on for your account, but this phone isn\'t one of your Guard devices. To add it, approve it from a device that is.
Add this phone to Aster Guard
On one of your Guard devices, open the Aster Guard notification and enter this number.
This phone is a Guard device
This phone can now approve sign-ins and changes for your account.
This request was denied on another device.
To protect your account, this change takes effect on %1$s. If you didn\'t make it, you can cancel it before then.
To protect your account, this change waits before it takes effect. If you didn\'t make it, you can cancel it before then.
When you turn a protection off, including Aster Guard itself, the change waits 24 hours. When you turn one on, it takes effect right away.
This turns off after the waiting period.
You have no rescue code. To keep a way back into your account, create one.
To change these settings, use one of your Guard devices.
Your changes weren\'t saved. To save them, verify it\'s you.
Replace the code you use to get back into your account
Your old rescue code no longer works. Keep the new one somewhere safe and offline.
Approve a sign-in without a notification
%1$s will no longer approve changes to your account. To use it again, join Guard from that device.
Turn it on to approve sign-ins and hold risky changes from this phone
Changes to your account wait here before they take effect.
These changes to your account are waiting before they take effect. If you didn\'t make one, cancel it.
When someone changes forwarding, recovery, or your password, the change waits here first so you can stop it.
This takes effect after the waiting period
You can skip the wait from a device you\'ve used for 7 days or more.
To skip the wait, use a device you\'ve used for 7 days or more, or your security key.
To cancel or stop a change, use one of your Guard devices.
Confirm this change to your account
This change already ended, so there was nothing to cancel.
Aster couldn\'t apply this change because your account changed after it was requested.
If you didn\'t start this recovery, stop it now. Your account stays as it is.
Aster Guard put this change on hold.
To link a mail app, approve it from a phone with Aster Guard.
This device\'s keys don\'t match. Start again on the device you\'re linking.
You can use this mail app after %1$s.
This mail app can send after %1$s.
Sign out other devices and cancel changes on hold.
If someone else got into your account, this locks them out right away.
This signs out every other device.
This removes Guard devices you didn\'t approve.
This cancels every change on hold.
You stay signed in on this phone.
To keep out anyone who knows your password, change it now. This change doesn\'t wait on hold.
Aster Guard is off on this phone
Enter the rescue code you saved when you set up Guard. Your account opens after a 72-hour wait, and your devices can stop it.
That rescue code didn\'t work. Check it and try again.
Rescue started. You can sign in after %1$s. Until then, any of your signed-in devices can stop it.
Aster Guard is off. Sign in with your password, and then set up Guard again to protect your account.
One of your devices stopped this rescue. If you didn\'t start it, no action is needed.
You stopped the rescue, so Aster Guard stays on. If you didn\'t start it, someone may know your password. Change it now to keep your account safe.
This link has expired or was already used.
The rescue couldn\'t be stopped. Try again, or sign in on an approved device to stop it.
Someone started a rescue that turns off Aster Guard.
Aster Guard is for high-risk accounts. Every new sign-in needs approval from a device you already approved, so a stolen password isn\'t enough.
Type the number from the new device on a phone you trust.
Password, recovery, and forwarding changes wait 24 hours, so you can stop them.
Get back in if you lose every device. Nobody at Aster can turn Guard off.
Approve a device that\'s always with you, such as your phone. Turning Aster Guard off waits 24 hours. Aster Guard is free on every plan.
New sign-ins need approval from one of your devices.
Off · Approve new sign-ins from your phone
The rescue is complete, and Aster Guard is off. To protect your account again, turn on Aster Guard.
A new device was approved to sign in to your account. If this wasn\'t you, tap This wasn\'t me.
New device added to Aster Guard
A new device can now approve sign-ins to your account. If this wasn\'t you, tap This wasn\'t me.
A device can no longer approve sign-ins to your account.
Aster Guard was reset after the 72-hour wait. If you didn\'t start this rescue, change your password immediately.
Aster Guard no longer protects your account. If you didn\'t turn it off, change your password immediately.
To ask your other device for approval, unlock this device with your fingerprint, face, or screen lock.
Check your internet connection, then try again.
This sign-in request was stopped. To continue, sign in again on the other device.
Skip the wait with a passkey
The passkey request was interrupted. Try again.
No passkey for this account is saved on this device. Use your password instead.
Passkeys aren\'t available on this device. Use your password instead.
That passkey belongs to a different account. Choose a passkey for the account you\'re using now.
You switched accounts while confirming. Switch back to that account, then try again.
The passkey request expired. Try again.
Your passkey couldn\'t be verified. Try again, or use your password.
This request changed or expired before Aster could check it. Start again.
Aster Guard is already on for your account.
This device can approve requests after %1$s.
This device can approve requests after its waiting period ends.
Only an approved Aster Guard device can do this. Use a device where Aster Guard is on.
This kind of device can\'t be added to Aster Guard. Update Aster and try again.
Aster doesn\'t recognize this device as one of your Guard devices. Add it again from a device where Aster Guard is on.
Aster Guard isn\'t available for your account.
This version of Aster can\'t finish this step. Update Aster and try again.
This device\'s Aster Guard key didn\'t match. Remove the device and add it again.
This is the last device that can approve sign-ins. To remove it, add another device first or turn Aster Guard off.
Your account doesn\'t allow this Aster Guard action.
To protect your account, Aster Guard paused new sign-in requests for a while. Try again later.
To protect your account, Aster Guard paused new sign-in requests. Try again after %1$s.
Another device already answered this request.
This request expired or was already answered. To try again, start a new request.
Aster Guard is on for this account, so a Guard device must approve this sign-in.
Aster couldn\'t finish this step because of a server problem. Try again in a few minutes.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
Too many attempts. Try again after %1$s.
Aster couldn\'t create keys on this phone.
To protect your account, Aster Guard paused new sign-in requests. Try again after %1$s.
The password is incorrect. While a password change is on hold, enter your current password, not the new one.
The authenticator code is incorrect. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Your security key couldn\'t be verified. Try again.
Too many incorrect attempts, so your account is locked. You can try again at %1$s.
Too many incorrect attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
